comment: Engine differences the probe records instead of failing; each still holds its WebKit value. observerOrder: the order between observers in one update. WebKit (Document::updateIntersectionObservers) delivers in the order observers gained their first target and moves an observer that lost all its targets to the end when it observes again; Chromium 156's order varies between updates. rootBounds: with a scrollMargin, WebKit reports the root bounds of a document or implicit root grown by the scroll margin, while Chromium reports them without it; both clip by the grown scrollport, so isIntersecting, the intersection rectangle and the ratio agree. elementRootScrollMargin: with an explicit root (the document here), WebKit clips targets by the scroll containers between target and root without the scroll margin (IntersectionObserver::computeIntersectionState passes no scrollMargin when root() is set), so #v, clipped 10px below #c, is not intersecting; Chromium grows those scrollports and reports it at 0.2. The recorded WebKit entries are asserted.
